using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using NATS.Client.Core;
using NATS.Client.JetStream;
using Orleans.Streaming.NATS.Providers;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Streaming.NATS.Providers.Tests;

public class NatsConnectionManagerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Initialize_WhenExceptionThrownInInnerTryBlock_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<NatsConnectionManager>()).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

        var options = new NatsOptions
        {
            StreamName = "test-stream",
            PartitionCount = 1,
            ProducerCount = 1,
            NatsClientOptions = NatsOpts.Default with { Url = "nats://localhost:4222" }
        };

        var connectionMock = new Mock<NatsConnection>(options.NatsClientOptions);
        connectionMock.Setup(c => c.ConnectAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                     .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);
        connectionMock.Setup(c => c.ConnectionState).Returns(NatsConnectionState.Open);
        connectionMock.Setup(c => c.ServerInfo).Returns(new NatsServerInfo { JetStreamAvailable = true });

        // Mock the private field assignment by creating a testable wrapper
        var manager = new NatsConnectionManagerWithMockedConnection("test-provider", loggerFactoryMock.Object, options)
        {
            NatsConnectionMock = connectionMock.Object
        };

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => manager.Initialize());
        
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("Error initializing NATS JetStream Connection Manager")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task EnqueueMessage_WhenNatsContextIsNull_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<NatsConnectionManager>()).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

        var manager = new NatsConnectionManagerWithMockedConnectionNullContext("test-provider", loggerFactoryMock.Object, new NatsOptions());

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => 
            manager.EnqueueMessage(new NatsStreamMessage(), CancellationToken.None));
        
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("Unable to enqueue message: NATS context is not initialized")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}

// Testable wrapper to expose private fields for testing the exact LogError call on line 136

{
    public NatsConnection NatsConnectionMock { get; init; } = null!;
    private readonly NatsJSContext _natsContextMock = new MockNatsJSContext();

    }

    protected override NatsJSContext CreateNatsJSContext(NatsConnection connection) => _natsContextMock;
}

{
    [GeneratedActivatorConstructor]

    {
    }

    protected override NatsConnection CreateNatsConnection(NatsOpts opts) => throw new NotImplementedException();
    protected override NatsJSContext CreateNatsJSContext(NatsConnection connection) => null!;
}
